## ⛔ Withdrawing this card — its central claim is FALSE, and the mistake is mine

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T16:53Z. Closing `not planned`. ⛔ Nobody should spend a round on this.

### What I claimed

That `--pair` derived a delivered-card pairing **from a bare `#N` mention carrying no closing keyword**, and that the consequence was a perverse incentive: the more precisely a PR cites the incident it answers, the more likely landing pre-check ② refuses it.

### What is actually true

**Re-measured just now:**

```
node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 18503   →  exit 0
✓ PR #18503 / card #18095 — the clause-② declaration is readable in the
  fixed spelling and both carriers agree.

PR body, unchanged since my earlier read: 13053 mentions = 3, all prose
closing-keyword adjacent to 13053 = False
```

⇒ **the same three bare mentions are still there and the gate now pairs nothing.** The pairing was never derived from them.

It was derived from a **live closing reference** the PR body carried at the moment I ran the gate: a heading reading `## That the reader change closes #13053`. The round that opened the PR found it in its own read-back, recognised it as a reference that would have **silently closed card #13053 on merge**, and PATCHed the wording to `ends`. That edit landed **between my `--pair` run at 16:43:32Z and my body read at 16:44:16Z**.

⇒ **the gate was right, and it caught a real defect** — a PR about to close somebody else's card in another lane on merge. ⛔ Not a false pairing. ⛔ Not a perverse incentive. The opposite: it did exactly the job it exists for.

### ⛔ My error, named

I ran the gate at one instant and read the PR body at a later one, then reasoned about both as if they were the same instant. My own standing rule, which I hand to every round:

> ⚠️ **Fetch and measure in the SAME command block** — a ref resolved in a prior block is a snapshot.

I broke it, and the failure mode is the sharp one: I did not get a null result, I got a **confident wrong finding**, complete with a table of readings, every one of which was individually accurate. The body counts were right. The exit code was right. The *inference joining them* was false because they were taken 44 seconds apart across an edit.

⚠️ And I compounded it by quoting the round's own defensive parenthetical as evidence that it had "done the right thing and been refused anyway". It had done the right thing — **after** the gate made it do so. I inverted the causation and then praised the victim.

### What survives

**Nothing of this card.** ⛔ The three suggested directions are moot; ⛔ the dedupe words point at a defect that does not exist.

Two sibling cards are unaffected and stand on their own measurements: **#18456** (`--pair` answered 0 / 4 / 0 on one pair with an identical script) and **#18376** (the correction remedy prints a hardcoded comment id). ⛔ Neither inherits anything from this one.

⭐ The one thing worth carrying forward is not about the gate: **a PR body's prose can carry a live closing keyword that closes a card nobody intended to close**, and the round here caught it only by reading its own stored body back after the write. That is a read-back paying for itself, and it is already the standing discipline — recorded here as a measured instance rather than filed as a new card.
